jobs.title: OCIP Workers Compensation Program Coordinator, Google Data Centers
jobs.description:
Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **San Francisco, CA, USA; Atlanta, GA, USA; Reston, VA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Healthcare, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program or project management.
* 2 years of experience handling workers compensation claims.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with claims management systems, Human Resource Information Systems (HRIS) platforms, and standard productivity tools (e.g., word processing, spreadsheets).
* Solid working knowledge of end\-to\-end workers compensation procedures, claims administration, and relevant state and federal labor laws.
* Comprehensive understanding of medical terminology, treatment protocols, and injury evaluation.

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.


The Workers Compensation and Owner Controlled Insurance Policy (OCIP) Program Lead oversees the strategic governance, placement, and daily administration of owner\-controlled insurance programs and occupational injury claims. This role drives end\-to\-end risk management by conducting exposure analyses, directing policy audits, and partnering closely with brokers and contractors to optimize coverage structures and ensure seamless program enrollment.


In addition to program strategy, the lead directs full\-lifecycle workers compensation claims management across employees, owners, and contractors. Acting as the primary liaison among injured workers, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and healthcare providers, the role coordinates quality medical care and facilitates prompt, modified\-duty return\-to\-work transitions. Furthermore, the position ensures regulatory compliance and workplace safety by delivering supervisor training, maintaining comprehensive claims databases, and analyzing incident trends to implement proactive, data\-driven injury prevention initiatives.


The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.


We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting\-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world\-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $159000 \- $230000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead end\-to\-end insurance placement and strategic risk mitigation across all operations. Manage data processing for policy placement, oversee policy audits, analyze program structures, and direct enrollments with OCIP brokers and contractors.
* Receive and process claims for owners, employees, and contractors, arrange medical care and facilitate return\-to\-work and modified\-duty accommodations.
* Serve as primary contact for injured workers, liaise with carriers, clinics, and legal counsel and maintain detailed incidents and financial records.
* Deliver supervisors claim training, analyze incident trends to prevent recurring injuries, and ensure alignment with workers compensation regulations.
* Evaluate risk exposures, design proactive risk control solutions, and build strategic vendor and insurer relationships.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (Shared Garden)
jobs.description:
**Shared Garden Coordinator**

*“Valley Verde is dedicated to building healthy and resilient communities by providing low\-income families educational programs, edible gardens, and micro\-entrepreneurship opportunities that create food security and lead to self sufficiency."*

**Location**: San Jose, Morgan Hill, and Gilroy, CA

**Program:** Shared Garden Program

**Job Type:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week

**Benefits:** Paid vacation/sick days

**Job Description:**

Valley Verde is an urban agriculture nonprofit based in San Jose uses home gardening as a catalyst for improving the long\-term health of underserved Santa Clara County residents. Valley Verde works with each participant for a year or more, providing a comprehensive set of culturally relevant services and resources to enable families to successfully grow their own organic produce gardens and prepare healthy meals with fresh vegetables. We are seeking a coordinator to expand our Shared Garden Program to reach low\-income families. Knowledge of the local area and community organizations local to the area would be beneficial for this role.

Essential job functions: Assist with program organization, implementing Shared Garden Program and assist with tracking all program data.

Tasks include, but are not limited to:

* Travel throughout Santa Clara County to facilitate monthly organic gardening workshops for participants of the Shared Garden Program
* Translate curriculum and facilitate workshops in Spanish
* Communicate via email, phone calls, text messages, or in person, on a monthly basis with participants regarding workshops, attendance, and upcoming events
* Collect and enter data monthly for participant attendance, home visits, and check\-ins
* Schedule and conduct monthly check\-ins, and quarterly garden visits with participants
* Create and upload training videos to online learning platforms, as needed
* In collaboration with the Program Manager, review and update curriculum, lesson plans, and programming as needed
* Troubleshoot garden issues including diseases and pests using organic methods
* Organize and assist with the distribution of garden materials (heavy lifting, 30\-40 lb bags)
* Assist with Planting Weeks and any other program events
* Represent Valley Verde and develop partnerships within the community
* Community outreach, recruit and enroll program participants, volunteers and interns through tabling events
* Assist customers with sales of seedlings at the site
* Assist with the Sow \& Grow Community Days
* Create Social Media content for the Shared Garden Program
* Other duties as assigned by the Program Manager

**Skills/Qualifications:** 

* Must have regular/reliable access to a vehicle with appropriate insurance for transportation
* Must be detail oriented and accurately report program attendance and other participant statistics
* Experience working in a multiethnic community environment
* Ability to develop professional relationships with program participants regardless of language barriers, cultural differences, or physical/mental abilities
* Ability to lift 30\-40 lbs for bed, soil and compost distribution
* Must be extremely organized and have the ability to prioritize projects to meet deadlines consistently
* Must be able to work independently and collaboratively in a team, show creativity, and ability to initiate and complete projects with limited supervision
* Bi\-lingual English/Spanish or English/Vietnamese required
* At least 1 year of teaching or group facilitation preferred
* At least 1 year of experience growing organic vegetables and urban gardening preferred
* Strong verbal and written communication skills required
* Excellent computer skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Google Suite, Mailchimp, and Canva
* Must be able to sit, stand, walk, lift, bend, and twist to complete garden projects and activities
* Experience operating power tools, building, and assembling irrigation systems is a plus

**Education:** 

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Community Development, or Education strongly preferred.
* Master Gardener’s certification is strongly preferred.
* Other related coursework or experience can be substituted.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $21\.00 \- $22\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Language:

* Spanish (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: People Operations Generalist
jobs.description:
At Sonatus, we're driving the transformation to AI\-enabled software\-defined vehicles. Traditional automotive software methods can't keep pace with consumer expectations shaped by the mobile industry—where features evolve rapidly, update seamlessly, and improve continuously. That's why leading OEMs trust Sonatus to accelerate this shift. Our technology is already in production across more than 8 million vehicles on the road today and rapidly expanding.



Headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA, with 250\+ employees worldwide, Sonatus combines the agility of a fast\-growing company with the scale and impact of an established partner. Backed by strong funding and proven by global deployment, we're solving some of the most interesting and complex challenges in the industry. Join us and help redefine what's possible as we shape the future of mobility.

**The Opportunity**



We're looking for a People Operations Generalist to own the programs our workforce relies on most and to be the first point of contact when employees have a question. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys running important processes with care and turning them into something repeatable. The ideal candidate handles confidential information, is comfortable being the go\-to resource for employee questions, and is motivated to improve the process rather than simply keep them running.


*This is a hybrid role based in our Sunnyvale office, with an expectation to work from the office three days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).*


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


* Serve as the first line for employee inquiries, responding promptly and accurately on policies, benefits, leaves, immigration, and general People Ops questions, and escalating as needed
* Own day\-to\-day immigration case management, coordinating with outside counsel, employees, and hiring managers on new petitions, extensions, transfers, amendments, and permanent residency filings
* Track visa expirations and case milestones, and keep employees and managers informed well ahead of deadlines
* Administer U.S. benefits programs end to end, including enrollments, qualifying life events, terminations, and carrier and broker coordination
* Run annual open enrollment, from plan communications and employee sessions to system setup and post\-enrollment audits
* Manage leaves of absence, including FMLA, CFRA, parental leave, and personal; serving as the point of contact for employees from first notice through return to work
* Own the employee onboarding experience, including review and redesign of the program as needed, pre\-hire communications, I\-9 and employment eligibility verification, and system and records setup
* Lead new hire orientation and continuously refine the content so new employees gain clarity on policies, benefits, and how the company works
* Perform maintenance of employee data and documentation in the HRIS, as well as compliance reporting and audits
* Take on ad hoc People Operations projects and initiatives as priorities shift, supporting programs such as the social/culture committee, employee engagement, or others as assigned


**Requirements**


* Minimum 3 years of experience in People Operations/Human Resources
* Working knowledge of U.S. employment\-related compliance, leaves of absence, I\-9 requirements, and benefits
* Strong operational mindset with the ability to build structure, improve processes, and drive execution
* Ability to operate effectively in high\-growth, high\-ambiguity environments with changing priorities and evolving business needs
* Result\-oriented and proactive approach — someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, makes sound decisions with imperfect information, and drives change
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to engage employees across the organization


**Sunnyvale HQ Benefits \& Perks Offered:**


* Health care plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision)
* Flexible and Dependent Care Expense program
* Retirement plan (401k)
* Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D)
* Unlimited paid time off per year, 14\+ paid holidays
* Hybrid office work arrangement
* Complimentary lunches, snacks, and beverages during on\-site working days
* Wellness benefit allowance
* Phone \& Internet reimbursement
* Computer Accessory Allowance

jobs.title: EHR Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
GeneDx (Nasdaq: WGS) delivers personalized and actionable health insights to inform diagnosis, direct treatment, and improve drug discovery. The company is uniquely positioned to accelerate the use of genomic and large\-scale clinical information to enable precision medicine as the standard of care. GeneDx is at the forefront of transforming healthcare through its industry\-leading exome and genome testing and interpretation services, fueled by the world's largest, rare disease data sets. For more information, please visit www.genedx.com.


**Summary**  

The Enterprise Program Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering large, cross\-functional programs that align with the company's strategic goals. This role ensures that multiple related projects stay on track, achieve broader business objectives, and drive organizational vision. The Program Manager serves as a central point of alignment across departments, managing resources, timelines, and risk to deliver program\-wide success.


**Job Responsibilities**


* Program Leadership: Oversee the entire program lifecycle, from inception to completion, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and company vision.  

	+ Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Act as the primary liaison across departments to ensure that all stakeholders are aligned and working toward common goals.
	+ Alignment and Planning: Develop program strategies in collaboration with senior leadership and define a roadmap for success with clear milestones.
	+ Risk and Issue Mitigation: Proactively identify and mitigate risks to ensure seamless progress, addressing
roadblocks before they impact program outcomes.  

	+ Resource Management: Coordinate resource allocation across projects to maximize efficiency and maintain
balance across the program.  

	+ Stakeholder Communication: Keep all relevant stakeholders informed of program progress, changes, and risks
through regular updates and communication.  

	+ Continuous Improvement: Drive process improvements across program operations, ensuring that best practices are followed and lessons learned are applied.


**People Manager**  

  

No


**Education, Experience, and Skills**

  

* Bachelor's degree in business, Life Sciences, Engineering or a related field.  

	+ Extensive experience (5\+ years) in program and project management, with a focus on cross\-functional
collaboration.  

	+ Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
	+ Demonstrated experience in implementing project management software.
	+ Exceptional verbal and written communication including an ability to communicate effectively at an executive
level.  

	+ Ability to work collaboratively across distributed workforce.
	+ Possesses significant practical experience in project management (project planning, resource planning, issue
management, risk management, change management, communication planning).  

	+ Excellent organizational skills and capable of setting priorities and a demonstrated ability to deliver projects on time, on budget and within scope.
	+ Proven accomplishment as a driver of multiple projects running concurrently.
	+ Exhibit good judgment skills on when to seek guidance and when to escalate risks and issues.


**Certificates, Licenses, Registrations**


* MP certification is highly desired but not required.


**Work Environment**  

  

This is a fully remote position. The employee will work from a home office or other suitable remote location with reliable high\-speed internet access. Work is performed in a climate\-controlled environment using standard office equipment including computer, phone, and video conferencing tools. Your standard work schedule and hours will be established in collaboration with your leader and may be adjusted to align with evolving business needs.

  



\#LI\-REMOTE



### **A culture that plays to win, because patients are counting on us**

At GeneDx, we're driven by urgency and purpose: helping patients get diagnosed earlier. Our mission, to empower everyone to live their healthiest life through genomics, drives our team to make a tangible impact each day – and shapes our culture where high standards, strong teamwork, and meaningful ownership are the norm. We act with intention, support one another, and deliver work we're proud to put our names on.
  

  

**Here's what you can expect day to day:**  

  

1\. Play like a champion (step up, redefine what's possible, own it)


We bring energy, focus, and a bias for action. We step up, take initiative, and deliver on our commitments – with quality, speed, and care.  

  

  



2\. Think bigger (stretch beyond, courage not consensus)
We push past the obvious. We challenge assumptions, raise the bar, and make thoughtful, decisive calls — choosing progress over perfection.  

  

  



3\. Grow fast (be curious, speak up, be agile)
We stay curious, ask questions, and share direct feedback with respect. We adapt quickly and keep learning through collaboration and continuous improvement.
  

  

If you're motivated by meaningful work, a fast\-moving environment, and teammates who care deeply about outcomes, you'll thrive at GeneDx.



At GeneDx, we believe in taking care of our people. We provide competitive compensation and benefits that reflect local market practices and legal requirements in each country where we operate, helping employees thrive both professionally and personally.

We welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.


**GeneDx is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.**

jobs.description:

Clean Harbors is seeking a Regional Account Manager to support the Retail Market Segment across the Western United States as part of the Technical Services Regional Account Sales team. This role is responsible for developing and growing strategic relationships with regional retail customers while expanding Clean Harbors' market presence throughout an assigned territory including strategic vision and execution of critical programs that develop and deepen our relationships within regional retail customers. The Regional Account Manager will identify new business opportunities, expand existing customer relationships, increase share of wallet, and position Clean Harbors as the preferred environmental services partner across all aspects of a retail customer’s operations.


\*\*\*Applicants may live anywhere in the US and should be no more than one hour from a major Airport\*\*\*

* Meet all account’s needs and deliverables according to proposed timelines, contracts, and agreements.
* Proactively resolve customer issues and complaints.
* Analyze customer data, working cross\-functionally with support teams, deepen customer relationship management through valuable insights and action plans.

* Expand share of wallet by introducing additional Clean Harbors service lines.
* Develop new regional retail prospects and convert them into long\-term customers.

* Conduct regular business reviews with assigned customers.
* Develop customer account plans identifying growth opportunities and strategic priorities.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction through proactive communication and issue resolution.

jobs.description:

Since its inception in 1986, Sporton International has been focusing on providing customers with professional product testing and certification services. With years of dedication, Sporton International has become a designated testing lab for regulatory bodies such as BSMI, NCC, and TAF and acquired professional certificates including PTCRB, GCF and CTIA. With solid credibility in the industry, Sporton International now is the largest test lab specializing in EMC/Safety tests.

The HR Generalist will manage daily HR operations, ensure compliance with California Labor Law, and handle tasks such as hiring, onboarding, training, benefits enrollment, and Workers' Comp. The role requires strong HR knowledge and interpersonal skills to support a high\-performance culture and workforce development. We will offer a salary package commensurate with experience.

1\. **Employee Relations**

* Address employee queries and resolve issues promptly.

2\. **Recruitment and Onboarding**

* Manage recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training.
* Handle job postings, candidate shortlisting, and interview scheduling.

3\. **HR Policies and Compliance**

* Update and enforce HR policies and company guidelines to ensure compliance with regulations.
* Maintain and revise the Employee Handbook and mandatory programs.

5\. **Benefits Administration**

* Coordinate benefits open enrollment and address employee benefit inquiries.
* Manage benefits\-related documentation and employee requests.

6\. **Records and Documentation**

* Maintain and organize employee records, benefits, and attendance.
* Ensure accurate documentation for employment verifications and internal tracking.

7\. **Government and Insurance**

* Respond to government agency inquiries and handle Workers' Comp claims.
* Manage compliance with federal and state employment regulations.

8\. **Training and Development**

* Support departmental and organizational training initiatives.

Note: Additional tasks may be assigned as needed.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources or a related field
* Proficient understanding of HR laws, regulations, and best practices
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational skills
* Analytical mindset with a focus on accuracy
* Fluent in English \& Mandarin (Required)

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Finance & Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About Latent**


Latent is building the clinical agentic engine for enterprise pharmacy—software that enables leading health systems to serve more patients, grow their pharmacy operations, and capture more value compliantly, without adding headcount. We are a fast\-moving team looking for thoughtful, ambitious people who want to help build both the business and the systems behind it.

**The Opportunity**


Latent is hiring a Finance \& Business Operations Manager to own the systems that keep the company running: our books, our billing, our spend, our insurance, and our payroll and expense operations. You will be the person who makes sure money moves accurately, on time, and with the right controls behind it.


This is a hands\-on ownership role, not an oversight role. You will work in QuickBooks, Brex, and Rippling directly, and you will design the policies and processes around them. You will partner closely with our strategic finance function—they build the model and the forecast; you own the operational reality that feeds it.


On any given day, you might reconcile a month\-end account, issue a batch of customer invoices, chase a receivable, review expense reports, renegotiate a software renewal, or work through an insurance renewal with our broker.

**What You’ll Do**

**Accounting and the books**

* Own day\-to\-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online, including categorization, reconciliations, and chart\-of\-accounts hygiene
* Run or support month\-end close, including accruals, prepaids, and account reconciliations
* Keep financial records accurate, organized, and audit\-ready
* Maintain the chart of accounts, classes, and departments so reporting stays meaningful as we grow
* Coordinate with external accounting, bookkeeping, and tax partners

**Invoicing and accounts receivable**

* Own customer invoicing end to end, including recurring, milestone, and usage\-based billing
* Ensure invoices are accurate, properly coded, and issued on schedule
* Track receivables, follow up on outstanding balances, and manage collections
* Resolve billing questions and discrepancies with customers and internal stakeholders
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success so contract terms flow correctly into billing

**Accounts payable, corporate cards, and spend management**

* Administer Brex: card issuance, spend limits, approval flows, receipt compliance, and reporting
* Review vendor bills for accuracy, proper approval, and correct coding
* Manage payment runs, track payment status, and resolve vendor discrepancies
* Own vendor onboarding, renewals, purchasing workflows, and contract records
* Maintain visibility into software subscriptions and other recurring commitments, and identify savings opportunities
* Evaluate vendors and negotiate commercial terms
* Partner with budget owners to ensure purchases are appropriate, approved, and within budget

**Personnel expense and payroll operations**

* Own employee expense management: policy, submission workflows, review, and reimbursement
* Support payroll processing in Rippling, including off\-cycle runs, and ensure accurate GL mapping into QuickBooks
* Maintain employee records and support onboarding, offboarding, and benefits administration workflows
* Serve as the first point of contact for employee questions on expenses, reimbursements, and payroll
* Partner with People and leadership so compensation changes flow correctly into payroll and the books
* Handle confidential compensation and employee data with consistently sound judgment

**Insurance and business administration**

* Own company business insurance: renewals, broker relationships, coverage reviews, and certificate\-of\-insurance requests
* Ensure coverage keeps pace with headcount, customer contracts, and our risk profile
* Maintain corporate records, state registrations, and business licenses
* Support customer and partner requests for insurance, tax, and compliance documentation

**Building the operations function**

* Identify manual or inefficient processes and replace them with better systems and controls
* Document financial and operational policies, approval thresholds, and operating procedures
* Help select and implement finance and operations tools as the company grows
* Take ownership of new operational priorities as they arise

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–6 years of experience in accounting operations, finance operations, business operations, or startup G\&A
* Hands\-on ownership of QuickBooks Online or a comparable general ledger—not just reviewing someone else’s work
* Direct experience running accounts payable, accounts receivable, and expense workflows
* Familiarity with corporate card and spend platforms (Brex, Ramp, or similar) and HR/payroll systems (Rippling, Gusto, Justworks, or similar)
* Excellent attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy
* Advanced proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets
* Strong organizational and project\-management skills, with comfort owning recurring deadlines
* Clear, thoughtful communication with colleagues, vendors, and external partners
* A proactive, low\-ego approach and willingness to take ownership
* Comfort operating in a fast\-changing environment with incomplete information

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working at an early\-stage or rapidly growing technology company
* Experience through a full month\-end close, an audit, or a finance systems migration
* Experience managing business insurance renewals or working directly with brokers
* Exposure to multi\-state payroll and payroll compliance
* Experience with procurement or spend\-management systems
* Interest in healthcare, pharmacy operations, or health technology

**What Success Looks Like**


Within your first year, you will have:

* Closed the books accurately on a predictable monthly cadence
* Made invoicing and collections run on schedule, with receivables actively managed
* Given company leaders clear visibility into vendor spend, subscriptions, and card activit

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About PredictHQ**


AI and forecasting systems have a blind spot: the real\-world conditions that shift demand land as surprises instead of signals. PredictHQ closes that gap. We're the real\-world context platform trusted by some of the world's largest enterprises, including Uber, Expedia, and CVS, explaining more than 60 percent of real\-world demand variability so businesses can make high\-stakes decisions on pricing, staffing, and inventory with confidence.

**Our Values**


PredictHQ is about teamwork to achieve huge things. We are building innovative and complex products, so our empathetic, hard\-working culture is key to our success. We are proactive in helping our teammates grow and thrive in their careers, as well as making sure everyone can put their family and friends first.


**Job Purpose:**


PredictHQ's go\-to\-market motion runs on a six\-stage, high\-touch customer journey: Awareness Education, Selection Commit, Onboarding Production, Adoption Impact, Expansion, and Renewal.


As Senior Revenue Operations Manager, you will own the model and ensure it is being followed across Sales, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Support, catch the gap between what's documented and what's actually happening in the field, and run a standing reporting and variance cadence that gives leadership a reliable view of both. You will work directly with the Sales Director, VP Marketing, Solutions Engineering Manager, Director of Data Quality, and CFO, each of whom depends on this role for a different view into the same system.


Your first 90 days are focused on three things: verifying the customer journey model holds up as each stage goes live, standing up a reporting cadence every stakeholder actually uses, and closing the specific adoption gaps that surface once real deals run through the new process.  

  

Success is a team that just gets on with it, backed by systems that work, with nothing unclear and nothing slowing them down.

##### **️ What You'll Do**

 **Customer journey**

* Make sure every stage of the customer journey across Sales, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Support is working the way it's designed to, and call out where reality drifts from the plan
* Own the Customer Journey documentation, ensuring it is accurate and up to date as things change in the field

**Systems \& tools**

* Own the Salesforce CRM end to end: data quality, configuration, simplification, standardization and adoption across the team
* Manage the GTM tech stack day\-to\-day: tool admin, integrations, and vendor evaluation across Salesforce, Gong, Outline, and other products

**Reporting \& forecasting**

* Run a regular reporting cadence for five stakeholders (Sales Director, VP Marketing, SE Manager, Director of Data Assurance, CFO), each getting the view into pipeline, conversion, and revenue that's relevant to them
* Support the Sales Director's weekly forecast process

**Planning**

* Partner with the Sales Director and CFO on Revenue Architecture Planning across acquisition, retention, and expansion
* Feed into capacity modelling: jobs to be done, territory and routing, quota, and SLA**s**

**Accountability \& rigor**

* Call out any targets that don't hold up against real data and challenge them before launch
* Deliver a thorough quarterly targets\-vs\-actuals review across all six stages, being clear about what's an execution problem versus a flaw in the model itself

##### **What You'll Bring**

* 5\+ years in a Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Marketing Operations role at a B2B SaaS company
* Hands\-on Salesforce experience: you can build reports, manage data hygiene, and configure Flows without needing an admin to do it for you
* Comfort operating inside a system someone else designed: you can diagnose where a process isn't holding up in the field without needing to redesign it first
* Strong analytical skills; comfortable with messy, live data and confident turning it into a clear narrative for non\-technical stakeholders
* Efficiency\-driven: Uses AI automation to handle routine tasks and focus on creative problem\-solving.
* Experience across the full customer journey, from Marketing to Sales to Implementation
* Comfortable running a standing reporting cadence for multiple functional stakeholders with different needs, spanning sales, marketing, technical, and finance audiences
* The judgment to distinguish an execution problem from a design problem, and the communication skills to raise either one directly without getting caught in the middle

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in high\-touch land and expand GTM motions
* Familiarity with Clay, Gong, or similar revenue tech
* Comfortable operating at startup pace, with limited processes, even where the core mandate is implementation rather than 0\-to\-1 build

**General**

* BA/BS required
* Applicants for this position must be a US citizen or have a valid United States work visa.
* Ensure that all activities are conducted in accordance with internal policies and procedures, applicable legislation, rules and standards, including relevant Acts, Advertising Standards Authority rules and regulations, and industry body requirements.
* Based in San Francisco, this role follows our hybrid approach \- combining the flexibility of working from home with time in the office to foster team connection and collaboration.

**Benefits**

* Health Insurance administered by Sequoia One
* Paid Birthday Leave and Paid Family and Friends Day Leave
* Strong focus on your training and development
* 10 weeks of fully paid parental leave
* Flexible work arrangements
* A hybrid work environment centred on collaboration, agility and fun
* Options in a fast\-growing company in its early stages
* $500 annual stipend to support your work\-from\-home setup

This position connects Operations, Scheduling, HR, and Payroll to resolve timekeeping exceptions before payroll is finalized.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Provide day\-to\-day supervision and support to fixed\-route operators, including work assignments, policy compliance, performance feedback, customer service, and operational problem\-solving.
* Monitor fixed\-route service delivery and assist with pull\-out, route coverage, reliefs, detours, incidents, field response, and other service needs as assigned.
* Review operator time records, daily assignments, attendance information, overtime, premiums, leave entries, and other pay\-related data for completeness and accuracy.
* Reconcile payroll/timekeeping information against dispatch logs, run assignments, schedules, exception reports, and approved documentation.
* Research and resolve timekeeping discrepancies in coordination with operators, supervisors, Dispatch, Scheduling, Human Resources, and Payroll.
* Ensure approved pay codes, work rules, contractual entitlements, and company policies are applied consistently and supported by appropriate documentation.
* Meet payroll deadlines by reviewing exceptions promptly, securing required approvals, and escalating unresolved issues before payroll cutoffs.
* Maintain accurate records related to time corrections, attendance exceptions, operator assignments, and payroll approvals.
* Train or coach supervisors and operators on timekeeping expectations, payroll procedures, documentation requirements, and recurring error prevention.
* Prepare routine reports on overtime, attendance, timekeeping exceptions, payroll corrections, and other operating trends for management review.
* Support investigations, customer concerns, accidents, incidents, or employee issues within the fixed\-route operation as assigned.
* Maintain confidentiality of payroll and employee information and follow WeDriveU internal\-control requirements.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.



**Minimum Qualifications**


* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor's degree in business, transportation, accounting, human resources, or a related field preferred.
* Three or more years of transit or transportation operations experience, with supervisory or lead experience preferred.
* Experience reviewing timekeeping, payroll, scheduling, attendance, or labor data strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of fixed\-route operations, operator work assignments, overtime, and attendance processes.
* Strong Excel, data review, documentation, and deadline\-management skills.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**


* Fixed\-route operations supervision
* Timekeeping and payroll review
* Data reconciliation
* Employee communication and coaching
* Policy and work\-rule application
* Confidentiality and attention to detail


**Work Environment and Physical Requirements**



Work is performed in an office, transit operations, and/or field environment depending on assignment. The position may require frequent use of computers and transit systems, communication by phone or radio, and interaction with employees, customers, and the public. Some assignments may require travel within the local service area, work around transit vehicles and facilities, and availability outside normal business hours for operational needs. The employee must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.


**Additional Information**



This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Responsibilities may be adjusted based on the final Collier County operating model, customer requirements, technology, service design, and business needs. WeDriveU is an equal opportunity employer.

**PROJECT MANAGER**

*About the San Francisquito Creek Joint Powers Authority (SFCJPA) –*

The SFCJPA is a local agency formed and funded by five entities: Cities of East Palo Alto, Menlo Park and Palo Alto, Santa Clara Valley Water District (Valley Water) and San Mateo County Flood and Sea Level Rise Resiliency District. We plan and implement multi\-benefit capital projects that reduce the risk of flooding in our member cities area. To accomplish this, we seek grant funding for design and construction for our flood risk reduction projects. We bid, award, and manage large consultant contracts, and we closely manage grant funding. We have an engaged community and strive to keep them informed of our work. SFCJPA staff reports to a Board composed of elected officials from our five member agencies.

The SFCJPA currently leads two major projects: Reach 2 Project, a flood risk reduction project along San Francisquito Creek, and SAFER Bay, a shoreline resilience project to protect communities from tidal flooding and sea level rise.

Our stream maintenance activities are a growing effort. We lead an annual maintenance walk of the creek to identify creek blockages, fallen trees, or other items that require action. We are currently in the process of obtaining a Creek Maintenance Permit that will allow us and our partner agencies to perform routine maintenance activities in accordance with permitting regulations.

*About the position –* 

The selected candidate will work a variety of SFCJPA projects as needed, with primary focus on the Reach 2 Project. The SFCJPA Comprehensive Plan describes our projects including monitoring and adaptive management of the completed Reach 1 project from Highway 101 to San Francisco Bay, and the SAFER Bay Project. The selected candidate will report to and work closely with the Senior Project Manager. This position has the potential for advancement to Senior Project Manager.

The SFCJPA is part of the San Francisquito Creek Multi\-Agency Coordination (SFC MAC) group. We provide Subject Matter Expertise by monitoring storm threats, and we coordinate recommendations to activate the SFC MAC. The SFCJPA also manages part of a watershed monitoring system that provides real\-time information on rainfall and streamflow conditions within the San Francisquito Creek watershed.

When requested, we support our member agencies by reviewing proposed development, residential remodel plans, or work in or adjacent to the creek. The SFCJPA does not have regulatory or enforcement authority. Our goal is to provide meaningful input during plan development to minimize development close to the creek in accordance with our member requirements and our Bank Stabilization and Revegetation Master Plan.

The SFCJPA is a small public agency, with an allocated staff of four full\-time positions. Work in this small team requires frequent and clear communication, the ability to perform other duties as assigned, and cross over into other areas of expertise to support the work of the organization.

The SFCJPA strives to provide a healthy work\-life balance. Work schedule and work location can be flexible. However, the role requires regular in\-field and in\-person work, including attendance at monthly board meetings, and other in\-person team meetings, and is not be a fully remote position. In addition, there may occasionally be a need to work on weekends, evenings, or holidays, particularly for public engagement.

· Communicate with residents and other stakeholders as necessary to discuss and resolve creek\-side issues

· Experience managing consultants on complex civil engineering and/or environmental projects with numerous stakeholders

**About the Role:**  

CBRE is seeking a motivated and results\-driven Project Manager to support the delivery of construction and renovation projects from initiation through closeout on an account in Fremont, CA. This role requires solid technical fundamentals, strong client service skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects with general oversight and guidance from senior project leadership.
  
The Project Manager supports the development of budgets and schedules, coordinates contractors and vendors, and helps ensure projects meet client expectations for quality, cost, and timing. The ideal candidate has a general contractor (GC) background and/or MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) experience, is a self\-starter, and thrives in a fast\-paced, technical environment. Experience supporting semiconductor or other high\-tech manufacturing clients is a plus. What You’ll Do:
  
Support the development of project estimates, proposals, and schedules, and assist in presenting them to clients.
  
Assist with subcontractor procurement, including competitive bidding, negotiations, and contract execution.
  
Monitor subcontractor and vendor performance to ensure adherence to project requirements, budgets, and schedules.
  
Manage project financials, including billing, budget tracking, change orders, and cost reconciliation, with support from senior team members as needed.
  
Create and maintain project schedules, tracking progress toward key milestones.
  
Spend significant time onsite to monitor quality, safety, and progress.
  
Maintain proactive, professional communication with clients, setting expectations and helping resolve issues.
  
Represent CBRE with professionalism, integrity, and strong client service on a highly technical semiconductor campus. What You’ll Need:
  
3–5 years of project management experience in construction; general contractor (GC) background strongly preferred.
  
MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) background highly desirable.
  
Experience supporting semiconductor or other advanced manufacturing/tech clients is a plus.
  
Track record supporting projects ranging from $250,000 to $5 million in value.
  
Working knowledge of estimating, subcontractor negotiation, contract administration, financial management, and scheduling.
  
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with general oversight and limited administrative support.
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, Project).
  
Degree in engineering, architecture, or construction management preferred; relevant experience required.
  
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical information to clients and internal stakeholders. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future
  
Why CBRE We lead by example, guided by the needs of the cities we inhabit, the communities we build, and the world we live in. The more perspectives we have, the more dimensions we’re able to see. A culture of respect, integrity, service, and excellence shapes our approach to every opportunity.
  
Our competitive and comprehensive benefits program was designed to make sure you feel valued with benefits that support the mental, physical, emotional, and financial health of you and your family.
  
Maintain your career momentum with the best tools and training in the industry. You’ll have everything you need to thrive in your role: challenging work, dedication to results, fast\-paced assignments, and a culture of constant learning.
  
Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DE\&I) are more than just values\- they’re a competitive advantage. By crafting a place where our employees are recognized for their contribution and given a chance to grow, we regularly open ourselves and our business opportunities.
  
Applicant AI Use Disclosure We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.
  
CBRE carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate’s education, training, and experience. The minimum salary for the Project Manager position is $104,500 annually and the maximum salary for the Project Manager position is $140,000 annually. The compensation that is offered to a successful candidate will depend on the candidate’s skills, qualifications, and experience.
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity:** CBRE is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We have a long\-standing commitment to providing equal employment opportunity to all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, veteran status, political belief, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
  
  

**Candidate Accommodations:** CBRE values the differences of all current and prospective employees and recognizes how every employee contributes to our company’s success. CBRE provides reasonable accommodations in job application procedures for individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance due to a disability in the application or recruitment process, please submit a request via email at recruitingaccommodations@cbre.com or via telephone at \+1 866 225 3099 (U.S.) and \+1 866 388 4346 (Canada).

jobs.title: Sr Program Manager, Keynote Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) keynotes reach millions of viewers and shape how the world understands cloud and AI. Behind every keynote is a team that turns complex technical ideas into clear, compelling stories for our biggest stages. We are looking for a Program Manager II to run the programs that bring these keynotes to life, coordinating across executives, content creators, product teams, and design partners to deliver presentations on time and at a high quality bar. If you are organized, resourceful, and excited by the challenge of managing high\-visibility programs where the details matter, this role puts you at the center of how AWS communicates its most important innovations.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own the end\-to\-end keynote development program, defining milestones, tracking deliverables, mitigating risks, and keeping production on schedule across multiple workstreams.
* Coordinate with executives, product teams, content leads, and design partners to align on themes, messaging, and priorities for each keynote.
* Identify process gaps in how keynotes are built and implement improvements that raise quality and reduce cycle time.
* Define and monitor program metrics to measure delivery performance, then use those insights to inform planning for future events.
* Apply generative artificial intelligence tools where appropriate to streamline documentation, status reporting, and program analysis.

  

A day in the life  

You start your morning checking the keynote production timeline and flagging any deliverables at risk of slipping. Mid\-morning, you run a working session with content leads and design partners to review the latest script draft and lock down next steps. After lunch, you pull together a status update for executive stakeholders, summarizing progress and open decisions that need their input. Between meetings, you are refining the intake process for new keynote requests, looking for ways to make the workflow smoother for the next cycle.  

  

About the team  

Our team sits within AWS and exists to ensure the most important stories resonate on the biggest stages, delivered by our most senior executives. We partner closely with product, engineering, design, and executive communications teams to produce keynotes for events like re:Invent and other major technology conferences. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a shared commitment to getting the details right. If you want to work on programs that shape how millions of people experience AWS innovation, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 2\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Knowledge of general AI tools
* Experience designing, implementing, and scaling upskilling, apprenticeship, or workforce development programs across large\-scale operations or corporate environments, including forecasting workforce needs and leveraging analytics to drive program decisions

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

jobs.title: Document Quality Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:** 

The Document Quality Manager is responsible for overseeing the quality control and quality assurance of as\-built documentation and closeout deliverables for construction of utility infrastructure projects. This role ensures all documentation accurately reflects final project conditions, meets contractual requirements, and complies with company and client processes and standards. The manager leads a team of Document Quality specialists and coordinates closely with project management, clients, and field teams to ensure timely and accurate project closeout, including electronic filing and records management within company systems.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:** 

**As\-Built Documentation Review**

* Lead the comprehensive review of as\-built drawings, redlines, and supporting documentation to ensure accuracy and alignment with final installed conditions.
* Verify completeness and consistency across engineering drawings, specifications, and field documentation.
* Ensure updates from field changes, RFIs, change orders, and design revisions are properly incorporated into final as\-built records.
* Identify discrepancies or missing information and coordinate with engineering, field teams, or subcontractors to resolve issues.
* Promote and foster continuous process improvement to meet or exceed internal and external quality targets

**Closeout Documentation \& Data Analysis**

* Manage the collection, review, and validation of project data shared by the client.
* Analyze close\-out\-phase documentation to identify gaps, trends, and compliance issues prior to final project handover.
* Ensure all documentation meets contractual requirements, regulatory standards, and internal quality procedures.
* Prepare final closeout documentation packages for client submission.
* Act as liaison between client and field team. Able to communicate with field workers as well as upper\-level managers

**Governance, Quality Assurance \& Process Management**

* Develop and maintain documentation review procedures, checklists, and quality standards for as\-built and closeout documentation.
* Implement quality control workflows to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Conduct internal quality audits of documentation prior to client delivery.
* Track documentation status, completeness metrics, and closeout readiness.
* Oversee electronic documentation management in compliance with retention policies.
* Facilitate and ensure alignment between internal vs external quality control standards in a dynamic working environment.

**Team Leadership**

* Oversee hiring, onboarding and retention of Document Quality Specialists; set team goals, development goals, performance management and conduct performance reviews.
* Supervise, mentor, and coordinate the work of a team of four document control specialists.
* Assign review tasks, monitor progress, and ensure deadlines for project closeout milestones are met.
* Provide training on documentation standards, systems, and quality procedures.
* Foster a collaborative and detail\-oriented team environment.
* Collaborate closely with internal field leadership to resolve documentation issues, report outcomes, identify solutions and drive increased collaboration across groups.

**Coordination \& Communication**

* Collaborate with project managers, project coordinators, construction teams, and subcontractors to obtain required documentation.
* Serve as functional owner for electronic document filing systems; folder structure configuration, workflows, and retention schedules to ensure documents remain organized, searchable and compliant throughout project life cycle.
* Provide status updates and reporting to project leadership regarding documentation readiness and risks.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Excellent attention to detail and document quality standards.
* Strong leadership, coaching and workload prioritization abilities.
* Proficiency with document management systems and project documentation tools.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
* Effective communication and cross\-functional coordination skills.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills when resolving documentation discrepancies.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in document control, project closeout, or quality assurance within construction, engineering, or infrastructure projects.
* Experience reviewing as\-built drawings and closeout documentation packages.
* Demonstrated experience supervising or leading a documentation team.
* Strong analytical skills for reviewing large documentation sets and identifying discrepancies.

Desired:

* Experience with construction closeout processes for large\-scale infrastructure or capital projects.
* Familiarity with utility industry documentation standards and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with digital document control systems (e.g., Monday.com, SharePoint, or similar platforms).

Pay: $105,000\.00 \- $158,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Can you verify the completeness and consistency across engineering drawings, specifications, and field documentation?
* Have you ensured updates resulting from field changes, RFIs, change orders, and design revisions are properly incorporated into the final as\-built records?
* How many years of experience do you have supporting Utility Construction?
* Do you have experience supporting any type of construction in the past please explain?
* Do you have experience with construction closeout processes for large\-scale infrastructure or capital projects?
* Do you have exposure with digital document control systems (e.g., Monday.com, SharePoint, or similar platforms).?

Ability to Commute:

* South San Francisco, CA 94080 (Required)

jobs.title: Assistant Estimator & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ARC Document Solutions** (**www.e\-arc.com**) is a global leader in digital printing and technology services, dedicated to helping businesses promote their brand and streamline access to critical information. With a network of over 140 service centers across the USA, Canada, UK, UAE, India, and China, we serve more than 60,000 customers, including some of the world's most renowned brands.  

  

Our team of approximately 1,400 employees is committed to delivering top\-class customer service across diverse industries such as retail, sports, entertainment, fitness, construction, education, healthcare, and technology. **Riot Creative Imaging** (www.riotcolor.com), our specialized visual color graphics division, excels in transforming spaces through immersive environmental graphics and sustainable printing solutions. As a certified minority\-owned company operating since 1990, ARC is proud of its heritage and unwavering commitment to quality and innovation.  

**Who we are looking for:**
We are looking for an **Assistant Project Coordinator \& Estimator** to support our digital print production team. The successful candidate is someone who enjoys working in a print environment. The primary duties include coordinating the print production cycle, combining technical cost analysis with project scheduling. This role calculates material, and machine costs to help create bids, while overseeing print job flow, acting as the liaison between clients and production teams, and ensuring quality standards are met.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Schedule and perform site surveys as needed
* Prepare accurate cost estimates, quotes, and pricing based on project specifications
* Review scope of work, materials, labor requirements, and production timelines
* Assist in managing projects from order entry through delivery
* Coordinate with Regional Color Manager, Project Manager, and production to ensure deadlines are met
* Customer communication regarding specifications, timelines, revisions, approvals, and updates
* Create and maintain IFP quotes, work orders, and production documentation
* Monitor print production progress, installation progress, and flag issues that may impact schedule or cost
* Interface with customers regarding scheduling, problem\-solving, job status, quotes, solutions
* Provide other forms of customer service as required
* Verify accurate files, specifications, and production requirements prior to release

 **Project Management Support**  

* Tracking multiple active jobs simultaneously while maintaining attention to deadlines and detail
* Follow up on customer approvals, proofs, and production stages
* Assist in coordinating delivery schedules and installation logistics
* Assist in resolving production, quality, or delivery issues as they arise
* Work in conjunction with Project Manager to maintain project flow and customer satisfaction
* Help prioritize urgent jobs and adjust schedules as needed based on production demands
* Assist in site surveys
* Effectively communicate with customer to understand scope of work and make recommendations when needed during on site survey/job site
  

**Estimating**  

* Interpret customer specifications, drawings, and bid documents to develop pricing through IFP
* Calculate material usage, labor, finishing, freight and outside vendor costs
* Request vendor pricing when needed for outsourced services or specialty material
* Ensure estimates align with company pricing standards and margin expectations
* Revise estimates as project scope changes
* Assist in preparing bid responses and proposal documentation
  

**Preferred Skills/Qualifications*** Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Excellent communication and customer service skills
* Ability to work under fast paced environment with strict deadlines
* Experience in large format color print production, graphics, signage, or related industry preferred
* Proficiency in estimating, order entry, and Microsoft Office systems
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite – Adobe Acrobat Professional, Illustrator, Photoshop
* Attention to detail and problem\-solving mindset

  

**Pay range:** $23\.00 to $28\.85 per hour, depending on experience.  

  

**ARC \| Riot** offers comprehensive health benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with a match, Company\-Paid Life Insurance, and an array of voluntary benefits which include STD, LTD, Voluntary Life, PTO, PEDs, employee Recognition Programs, Spot Awards, and more!  

  

If you require reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process due to a disability, please submit your request to **jobs@e\-arc.com** and use the words “Accommodation Request” in your subject line.

jobs.title: Traveling Onsite Service Operations Specialist - San Francisco Bay Area
jobs.description:
**The** **Opportunity:**
------------------------


In this role, you will report to the Supervisor of Operation Specialist and will work closely with the Avantor’s Lab and Production Services professionals to serve our customers by performing customized, mission\-based lab work and research protocols that help return time back to science.


**Hourly Rate:** $27 \- $31

**Shift:** Monday–Friday, 7 am – 4 pm or 8 am \- 5 pm

**Location:** Looking for someone who lives in the South/East Bay Area; Willing to travel to Santa Clara and Livermore and South San Francisco

**Benefits:**

* Health and Wellness: Medical, Dental, Vision, and Wellness programs (eligible for medical coverage on day 1\)
* Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO), Company paid holidays, Choice holidays etc.
* Financial Well Being: Spending Accounts: Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Accounts (HSA), commuter benefits, 401(k), tuition assistance, employee stock purchase plan discount
* Added Protection Coverage: To include critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident, legal, identity theft protection, pet, auto and home insurance
* Recognition: Celebrate your peers and earn points to redeem on gifts and products

**What we’re looking for**

* **Education:** High school diploma or GED is required; Associates degree or undergraduate degree in a business or science\-related field is a plus.
* **Experience**: 3\+ years of experience in Inventory control/procurement/shipping and receiving/Inside Sales, etc., a plus
* **Collaboration Tool:** Microsoft Suite Experience
* **Overnight travel is required; you will be able to receive an overnight travel bonus**
* Will be using your own vehicle and the ability to fly (If traveling further out)
* Sites where coverage is provided require associates to be fully vaccinated and boosted against COVID\-19
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs
* Previous experience working in a GMP facility is strongly desired
* Strong communication skills
* Knowledge of Information Access and System ESS
* A valid driver's license is required to perform the essential functions of the job
* Ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
* Traveling between multiple locations in the San Francisco area
* Mileage reimbursement for miles driven to client locations
* Having a CDL is a plus, not a requirement
* Cross\-referencing and inside sales experience are a plus
* Forklift Certification is a plus
* Prior experience with VWR/Avantor products and services is a plus
* IATA, DOT, OSHA Right to Know, IMDG a plus

 **How you will thrive and create an impact**


Avantor’s Lab and Production Services team is a crucial part of the Avantor Services group serving over 500 customers in biopharma, pharmaceutical, educational, industrial, and high\-tech industries with customizable, flexible solutions and end\-to\-end laboratory operations support.


**In this role you will:**

* Support multiple facilities and/or customers in a strategic geographic area and may perform the job functions of Coordinators, Technicians, Material Handlers, Glass Washers when scheduled vacations, leave, and /or emergency situations occur.
* Act as a backup to other territories and may require travel outside of the designated territory.
* Coordinates and leads team efforts and performs work related to customer requirements.
* Works closely with management to complete projects such as Standard Operating Procedures, Scopes of Work, Standard Work, On\-The\-Job Training, and other assorted tasks, along with direct customer interfacing relative to job functions.
* Interfaces directly with customer Point\-of\-Contact, purchasing directors, facility directors, and plant managers etc. to procure lab supplies and materials.
* Utilizes Avantor and customer computer systems: SAP, Inventory Manager, Chemical Manager, and/or other customer\-specific applications.
* Trains Avantor Lab and Production Services associates on all service offerings.
* Provides SAP Support (Full customer services, credit rebills, and invoice scrubbing).
* Modifies and maintains quality metrics and key performance indicators.
* Manages a budget related to expense reports.
* Meets revenue, TOE, safety, performance, and quality goals and objectives
* Creates programs for enhanced service efficiencies.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
**Disclaimer:**
---------------


The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this position. Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Specialist

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Industry:** Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing / Precision Manufacturing  
**Department:** Quality  
**Schedule:** Monday–Friday

Job Summary

We are seeking a detail\-oriented and hands\-on **Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) Specialist** to join our semiconductor equipment manufacturing team.

The QA/QC Specialist will be responsible for inspecting incoming, in\-process, and finished components to ensure compliance with engineering drawings, customer specifications, and internal quality standards. This position will also support quality documentation, non\-conformance management, corrective actions, supplier quality, and continuous improvement activities.

The ideal candidate has experience in **precision machining, semiconductor equipment, or high\-precision manufacturing** and is comfortable working with engineering drawings, inspection equipment, and quality documentation.

Key Responsibilities

* Perform **incoming, in\-process, and final inspections** of precision machined parts, fabricated components, assemblies, and purchased materials.
* Inspect parts according to **engineering drawings, specifications, tolerances, and customer requirements**.
* Use inspection and measurement equipment such as **calipers, micrometers, height gauges, pin gauges, thread gauges, surface roughness testers, optical measurement systems, and CMM equipment**, as applicable.
* Review and interpret **engineering drawings, GD\&T, dimensions, tolerances, surface finish requirements, and inspection criteria**.
* Verify material certifications, inspection reports, Certificates of Conformance (CoC), and other supplier quality documentation.
* Document inspection results accurately and maintain complete, traceable quality records.
* Identify, document, and control **non\-conforming materials and products**.
* Generate and manage **Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs)** and coordinate disposition with Engineering, Manufacturing, Purchasing, and other departments.

* Support supplier quality activities, including communicating quality issues, reviewing corrective actions, and monitoring supplier performance.
* Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve dimensional, workmanship, documentation, and manufacturing quality issues.
* Support customer quality requirements and assist with customer complaints, returns, and corrective action requests when necessary.
* Ensure inspection tools and measurement equipment are properly maintained and within calibration.
* Assist with maintaining and improving quality procedures, inspection instructions, forms, and work instructions.
* Support internal and external quality audits as required.

* Experience inspecting **CNC machined components and precision mechanical parts** is highly preferred.
* Ability to read and interpret **mechanical drawings, dimensions, tolerances, and GD\&T**.
* Hands\-on experience using precision measurement and inspection tools.
* Understanding of **quality inspection processes, NCRs, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and document control**.
* Familiarity with **ISO 9001 or similar Quality Management Systems (QMS)** is preferred.
* Experience with CMM inspection is a plus.

* Ability to prioritize multiple inspections and quality issues in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

* Incoming Quality Control (IQC)

* Root Cause Analysis

* 5 Why / Fishbone analysis
* ISO 9001
* Calibration management

Physical Requirements

* Ability to safely handle and inspect mechanical components of various sizes.
* Ability to lift up to **30 lbs.** as needed.
* Ability to visually inspect precision components and use measurement equipment accurately.

jobs.title: Office Manager / Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About Us**

  

Medical data exchange is one of the biggest unsolved problems in US healthcare. If you've spent any real time in the healthcare system, you've felt it, and it only gets worse the sicker and older you get. Metriport exists to fix that. We connect to the data sources the healthcare providers of tomorrow need, take raw data that's unusable in its source form, and turn it into a single clean format that care teams, and their agents, actually use to improve outcomes. Record retrieval across thousands of legacy systems and antiquated data pipes that used to take weeks now takes seconds. Clinicians walk into appointments with the full patient picture already in hand, and that speed can mean spotting a condition early enough to actually treat it.


We're not a healthcare company. We're a technology company that happens to operate in healthcare, and we build every layer ourselves: connect, transform, and insight. Legacy EHRs were built to get providers paid, not to serve the clinical experience. We're building what should have existed instead: the system of record for all of US healthcare. We started in data exchange. Today we compete with the largest data platforms in the space. Tomorrow we will be the infrastructure layer healthcare runs on.


We’ve raised $28\.4 million from top\-tier VCs (including Matrix, ARTIS and Y Combinator), found product\-market fit (multi\-million dollar ARR, 100\+ customers including Amazon One Medical, Circle Medical, Color Health, and Strive Health), and have years of runway ahead of us. If you’ve had a good healthcare experience in the past few years, there’s a good chance Metriport was behind it. That’s the version of healthcare we want people to not just expect, but demand. Join us and build the future.  

  

**About You**

We're a small, high\-output team, mostly former founders including YC alumni, and we operate with real autonomy and almost no bureaucracy. We hire on competence, not pedigree. Leaders are in the office six days a week, and we generally expect the team to be available six days a week too. Not because we count hours, but because there's always more wood to chop when revolutionizing how tomorrow’s healthcare providers deliver care to their patients today. We trust our team to take the time off they need and we've never said no to a time off request.  

  

You have an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong sense of ownership. You don't wait to be told what's broken. Instead, you believe you can figure out any problem that lands in your lap even outside your exact domain. When someone scopes something for three weeks, you ask why it can't be done in three days, and you also know the difference between shipping a fast v0 and cutting a corner that comes back to bite you. You walk the tightrope between craft and speed without falling off either side.

**The Role**


We’re looking for an Office Manager / Executive Assistant to keep our SF office running and support our leadership team. This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role with direct impact on how we operate day\-to\-day. You’ll be in our SF office Monday through Friday.


You’ll split your time roughly equally between office operations and executive support with cross\-functional opportunities. If you’re energized by building systems from scratch, thrive when no two days look the same, and want a path into People / HR as the company scales—this role was built for you.


**What You’ll Do**

**Office Management**

* Own the SF office experience end\-to\-end: supplies, snacks, equipment, vendors, and facilities
* Lead office build\-out initiatives as we grow: coordinate with contractors, landlord, and vendors
* Plan and execute internal events (team offsites, all\-hands, celebrations, customer visits)
* Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts for office services
* Maintain operational docs and processes in Notion; coordinate team communication in Slack and Linear
* Support onboarding logistics for new hires and assist with People / HR projects over time

**Recruiting coordination and sourcing**

* Work with our internal recruiter on sourcing and screening candidates
* Build and maintain sourcing funnels, craft personalized messages, and track response rates
* Schedule and coordinate initial calls with candidates and follow\-up meetings between candidates and hiring managers

**Executive Support**

* Manage complex calendars for both leaders: scheduling internal meetings, external calls, and personal appointments across time zones
* Coordinate domestic travel: flights, hotels, ground transport, and itineraries
* Track follow\-ups, action items, and commitments so nothing falls through the cracks
* Draft and send communications on behalf of leadership as needed
* Assist with ad hoc research, vendor outreach, and special projects

**Requirements**

* **Experience:** 1–2\+ years as an Office Manager, Executive Assistant, or similar role at an early\-stage startup
* **Presence:** Based in San Francisco; available in\-office 5 days per week (Monday\-Friday mornings)
* **Startup DNA:** You’re comfortable with ambiguity, can prioritize across competing demands without hand\-holding, and enjoy building things from scratch
* **Organized by default:** You maintain clean systems for calendars, tasks, and follow\-ups without being reminded
* **Strong communicator:** Clear and professional in writing and in\-person; comfortable interfacing directly with founders and external partners
* **Proactive:** You identify problems before they surface and propose solutions, not just questions
* **Tool\-savvy:** Proficient with Notion, Slack, and Google Workspace; bonus if you’ve used Linear

**Preferred:** Interest in growing into a People/HR Operations role as Metriport scales
