new_jobs.description:
Amphenol Communications Solutions (ACS), a division of Amphenol Corporation, is a world leader in interconnect solutions for Communications, Mobile, RF, Optics, and Commercial electronics markets. Amphenol Corporation is one of the world’s largest designers and manufacturers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor\-based products and coaxial and high\-speed specialty cable. ACS has an expansive global presence in research and development, manufacturing, and sales. We design and manufacture a wide range of innovative connectors as well as cable assemblies for diverse applications including server, storage, data center, mobile, RF, networking, industrial, business equipment, and automotive.

 **Position: Account Manager**

**Location: Santa Clara, CA**


Amphenol High Speed and Commercial Products Groups are the market leaders for high speed, high bandwidth electrical connectors for the Telecom/Datacom and Diverse market (Mobile Networks, Storage, Servers, Routers, Switches, etc.). Our products help to enable the electronics revolution and remain a key enabler for all the major Tier 1 OEMs globally. Our global headquarters are located in Nashua, NH and we have design, sales, and manufacturing locations globally. We are currently seeking an Account Manager to join our West Coast Sales team in Santa Clara, CA.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**


The Account Manager is the voice of the customer into the organization as well as the voice of Amphenol out to the customer. This highly visible role will have responsibility for one of the largest OEM customers within the High Speed Products Group. The position requires excellent communication skills but also has a substantial focus on financial and market data.

* Preparing monthly and quarterly revenue projections for the account(s)
* Forecast analysis and preparing book\-to\-ship estimates
* Preparing negotiation strategy in conjunction with sales and product line management, submitting proposals and negotiating order fulfillment agreements to maximize share
* Coordinating customer activities, including product ramp strategies and resolution of delivery, quality, inventory, and financial issues in an international environment
* Prepare market share goals and work with sales, product management and operations to achieve those objectives and resolve any shortfalls to the plan
* Identify end customer market analysis/opportunities and develop plans to fulfill gaps to close the total available market space


A successful candidate will be skilled at working with a high level of detail and will be able to manage multiple tasks for customers in a time sensitive environment. They will also make presentations to top management; organizational skills and summarizing conclusions via data analysis is an important part of the position. To do so requires a strong working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint and the ability to communicate effectively. Some travel may be required.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* BS Degree in Marketing, Business or related area, MBA preferred
* Bi\-lingual Spanish/English Required
* Advanced PC Skills in MS Excel and PowerPoint, working ability with V\-lookups, Pivot Tables, and other more advanced excel skills
* 3\+ year of experience in Marketing, Customer Service, Planning or Finance
* Ability to effectively communicate across multiple functions internally and externally
* Strong oral and written communications to provide high level customer service and build relationships
* Detail\-oriented with keen business acumen


The base salary range for this position is $68,320 \- $104,400 annually. In determining rate of pay, Amphenol considers a variety of nondiscriminatory factors, including but not limited to geographic location, relevant industry experience, qualifications, skills, and education. It would be rare for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for a given role. Base salary is one facet of Amphenol's total rewards package which includes participation in our comprehensive benefits program with medical, dental, and vision benefits effective day 1, vacation, sick leave, personal days, paid holidays, life insurance, short/long term disability, and matching 401K.

  

Amphenol Corporation is proud of our reputation as an excellent employer. Our focus is to provide the highest level of support and responsiveness to both our employees and our customers, the world's largest technology companies. Amphenol Corporation offers the opportunity for career growth within a global organization. We believe that Amphenol Corporation is unique in that every employee, regardless of his or her position, has the ability to positively impact the business.


Amphenol is an “Equal Opportunity Employer” \- Minority/Female/Disabled/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin. For additional company information please visit our website at https://www.amphenol\-cs.com/

new_jobs.description:
**Case Manager (RRC)**


**Hybrid Remote/In\-Person Full\-Time (40 hrs/wk) Position in Oakland, CA (Non\-Exempt)**


**Who We Are**



Ruby's Place dba Restorative Pathways (RP) is an innovative nonprofit committed to ending domestic violence, human trafficking, and violent crime through hope, advocacy and connection. Our services include emergency shelter, transitional housing, rental subsidies, mental health services, substance recovery, and wrap\-around services. All our services are trauma\-sensitive and client\-centered and are provided at no cost to our clients. All programs are low barrier.


RP is led by survivors with a focus on reflection, innovation, and connection. We believe in fostering relationships, both in our direct service work and throughout our internal work culture. We aim to cultivate a workplace that appreciates and emphasizes the voices of those most impacted by violence. We recognize these voices are vital to interrupting the cycle of violence and transforming lives towards safety, unity, and trust.


**Who You Are**



You have a strong commitment to preventing interpersonal violence as well as an understanding of, and sensitivity to, serving diverse populations. You have excellent interpersonal skills and strong techniques for relationship building. You believe people should determine their own path towards healing, and have an orientation towards survivor\-centered services.



You are a go\-getter who enjoys fast paced environments. You enjoy working both collaboratively and independently. You are adept at time management and highly organized with a proven ability to ensure you can meet deadlines, plan, organize and execute. You are comfortable working as part of a team and are an accountable collaborator. You excel at organizing, prioritizing, and following through on multiple time\-sensitive projects. You are flexible, creative, and take initiative in handling emergencies.


***What qualifications are required for this position?***


**Required:**


* High school diploma or equivalent (GED) required.
* Ability to pass all required background screening prior to hire, including criminal background check and DOJ/FBI fingerprinting, per RP and California DHCS requirements.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage and track a caseload of clients with competing deadlines and needs.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills, including comfort documenting in an electronic medical record.
* A calm, non\-judgmental, and compassionate approach to working with clients in recovery and their families.
* Ability to work collaboratively across residential, clinical, and medical teams.
* Valid California driver's license and reliable transportation, if assisting with client transportation coordination.
* In possession of a valid CA driver's license, proof of insurance, and be approved by RP insurance as a driver in order to drive agency vehicles. If a staff member cannot be approved by RP insurance as a driver, employment might not be able to continue. Instances where staff cannot be approved to drive will be reviewed on a case by case basis to determine if employment can continue in their role without driving agency vehicles. Items considered include but are not limited to: the shift the staff member holds and the frequency/necessity of driving during that shift, the amount of time before the staff member may be approved to drive by the insurance carrier, the availability of other staff on site to drive agency vehicles as program needs require, etc.
* Able to complete all required background checks. Additional requirements may be deemed necessary, including fingerprinting (Live Scan), completion of all Community Care Licensing (CCL) documents, and ability to meet CCL licensing requirements.


**Preferred:**


* Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, human services, or a related field.
* Prior experience in case management, care coordination, or a related support role, ideally in a behavioral health or SUD treatment setting.
* Familiarity with community resources in the Oakland / Bay Area region (housing, employment, benefits, legal aid, healthcare).
* Registered or certified AOD (alcohol and drug) credential, or working toward one — not required for this role, but a plus.
* Bilingual ability, and experience working with culturally and linguistically diverse clients and families.


**What You Will Do**



Riley Recovery Centers (RRC) is a program within Restorative Pathways. RRC provides safe, compassionate, evidence\-based substance use disorder (SUD) treatment for youth and adults. RRC operates a single integrated continuum of care on one property: clients live on\-site in a supervised, home\-like sober living residence while attending structured clinical programming — Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP, ASAM Level 2\.5\) and Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP, ASAM Level 2\.1\) — delivered through individual, group, and family sessions. RRC believes recovery is possible for every person, and our team works together across housing, clinical, and medical services so that treatment feels like one connected experience rather than separate programs under one roof.



RP is hiring a full\-time Case Manager within RRC to serve as the connective thread between our sober living residence and our PHP/IOP clinical programs. This is a non\-clinical, client\-facing coordination role: you will not provide therapy or counseling, but you will be the person who makes sure every client's practical, logistical, and support needs are identified, tracked, and followed through on — from a scheduled appointment or a referral to community services, to helping a client in their final weeks of sober living line up a job and permanent housing. You'll work closely with the Program Manager, AOD Counselors, the House Manager, and RRC's clinical and medical team, and you'll be a steady, organized presence for clients navigating a lot of moving pieces at onc

new_jobs.title: Wine & Spirits Sales + Operations Associate
new_jobs.description:
**Love wine and spirits? Come work with us.**

Blackwell's Wines \& Spirits is an independent, family\-owned retailer that has been serving the Bay Area for more than 22 years. With two locations and a thriving e\-commerce business, we work with an extensive and constantly changing selection of wines and spirits from around the world—from everyday favorites and new discoveries to rare and allocated releases.

We're looking for a **wine and spirits enthusiast** in our **San Francisco location** who enjoys working with people, takes pride in doing things well, and wants to deepen their product knowledge.

This is a hands\-on role combining **wine \& spirits, customer service, e\-commerce, merchandising, and retail operations.**

**What You'll Do**

* Help customers discover and select wines and spirits
* Learn about new products, producers, regions, and releases
* Receive, merchandise, organize, and stock inventory
* Fulfill and carefully pack e\-commerce orders
* Assist customers in\-store, by phone, and email
* Create product POS materials and assist with light computer/admin work
* Help keep the store organized, polished, and running smoothly

We're a small team, so everyone pitches in. Some days are customer\-focused; others are driven by new arrivals, special releases, or a busy e\-commerce queue.

**Who We're Looking For**

You'll be a great fit if you:

* Have a working knowledge of wine and spirits and are eager to learn more
* Are polished, friendly, and enjoy helping customers
* Are dependable, organized, and detail\-oriented
* Like staying busy and take ownership of your work
* Communicate well in person and in writing
* Are comfortable with computers and learning new systems
* Enjoy working independently and as part of a small team

Experience in **wine \& spirits retail, specialty food, restaurants, bars, hospitality, or customer service** is especially welcome.

**Qualifications**

* 3\+ years of retail, hospitality, or customer\-facing experience
* Working knowledge of wine and spirits beyond the beginner level
* Strong communication, organizational, and computer skills
* Ability to lift 40–50 pounds
* Must be at least 21 years old

**Why Blackwell's?**

If you love wine and spirits, this is an opportunity to **deepen that knowledge every day** while working with an extraordinary range of products, experienced colleagues, and industry professionals.

We're an established independent retailer—not a big\-box store—and every member of our team plays an important role.

**If wine and spirits are something you find yourself reading about, tasting, collecting, recommending, or simply wanting to understand better, we'd love to hear from you.**

Pay: From $23\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.description:
**Bay Padel is hiring Operations Associate Team Members in Sunnyvale, California**

**About Bay Padel**

Bay Padel is the Bay Area's fastest\-growing padel, pickleball, and wellness club, with locations across San Francisco and the South Bay. We exist to build a professional, inspiring environment where people of all backgrounds can connect, grow, and find belonging through the consistent pursuit of excellence, community, and personal elevation.

We are building a place where members come to compete, improve, and belong, and where the team behind the experience takes as much pride in the details as the players do on the court. As we expand across California, we are looking for people who share that standard.

**About the Role**

The Operations Associate is responsible for delivering a high\-quality daily experience at Bay Padel. This is a front\-desk–facing role and the first point of contact for members and guests, with ownership over club presentation, inventory, and smooth daily operations. The role also plays a key part in building community and ensuring a welcoming, well\-run club environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Member Experience \& Front Desk***

* Serve as the primary front desk contact for members and guests
* Create a welcoming, professional, and community\-driven environment
* Manage court bookings, memberships, POS transactions, and member accounts via PlayByPoint
* Handle inquiries, calls, billing questions, and issue resolution with care and urgency
* Build relationships with members and actively promote programs, leagues, and events

***Outreach***

* Proactively reach out to members and prospects (calls/texts) to fill open courts, book reservations, and convert first\-time visitors into repeat bookings
* Organize and fill open play sessions and games by matching players to available courts and skill levels

***Club Operations \& Facility Ownership***

* Maintain high standards of cleanliness, organization, and club presentation
* Conduct regular walkthroughs and address operational issues proactively
* Coordinate with vendors and escalate maintenance issues when needed
* Ensure storage areas, equipment, and supplies are organized and maintained

***Inventory Management***

* Conduct monthly inventory counts (pro shop, food \& beverage) and report results
* Receive, verify, and organize incoming deliveries
* Monitor stock levels and flag replenishment needs

***Events \& On\-Site Support***

* Support execution of club events during scheduled shifts
* Assist with setup, breakdown, and real\-time operational needs
* Ensure smooth guest experience during events

***Operations \& Improvement***

* Identify opportunities to improve workflows and member experience
* Support implementation of new processes and systems

**What We’re Looking For**

* Available at least 16 hours per week
* Conversational English
* Based in the Bay Area
* Customer\-focused and team\-oriented
* Bonus: experience in sales or the sports industry

Job Types: Full\-time, Part\-time, Temporary, Contract

Base Pay: From $23\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* What sport experience do you have, if any? (Sports you play, have coached, or experience working in the sports or fitness industry.)
* When are you available to start?
* What days and times are you generally available to work?
* Why are you interested in working at Bay Padel?

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Staff Technical Account Manager (Tax)
new_jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


Join the Data, Growth and Experiences (DGX) team as a Staff Customer Experience professional focusing on technical account management for data connectivity in TurboTax. The Technical Account Manager (TAM) in the tax sector serves as an ambassador of customer obsession, and functions as a critical link among our tax data partners, the IDX platform, and product management and development teams across offerings. The role demands a blend of product knowledge, API fluency and banking/payroll industry understanding. The TAM acts as a trusted strategic partner, proactively monitoring KPIs and creating roadmaps to address optimization opportunities and meet the needs of internal and external stakeholders. This includes providing technical and domain SME guidance and maintaining an operational feedback loop in order to ensure high\-quality and high\-performance done\-for\-you tax experiences for Intuit's customers.

 **Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary operational contact for strategic tax partners, ensuring high levels of partner satisfaction and engagement.
* Develop a deep understanding of partners' business objectives and technical capabilities to effectively position and support tax season readiness.
* Provide proactive technical guidance and recommendations to partners, anticipating potential challenges and offering solutions.
* Manage and prioritize partner connectivity issues, working closely with product and support teams to ensure timely resolution and clear communication to the partner.
* Conduct regular partner reviews to share KPIs and YoY performance insights, identify areas for improvement, and present new features or solutions.
* Own content for the tax partner portal, expanding self\-serve opportunities for documentation, tools and performance feedback.
* Contribute to the creation of technical documentation, best practices, and knowledge base articles.
* Represent the partners' capability asks and feedback internally, ensuring partner needs are reflected in product roadmaps when appropriate.

 **Qualifications**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong familiarity with US taxpayer forms, including W\-2, 1099 investment and retirement income, and 1098 mortgage deductions.
* Proficiency in understanding and articulating complex customer experience flows related to APIs and system integrations, including authentication, authorization and consent flow protocols.
* Experience navigating Tableau, Splunk, SQL (querying) etc for data analysis and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce)

 **Soft Skills**

* Customer obsession is a must. The ideal candidate will have excellent customer service with a collaborative mindset.
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical information to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
* Exceptional problem\-solving and analytical abilities, with a focus on partner success.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proactive and results\-oriented with a strong partner\-centric mindset.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team.

 **Preferred Qualifications**

* Fluency in RESTful APIs and relevant authentication protocols (OAuth, OIDC).

-------------


TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end\-to\-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world\-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.


Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.


We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast\-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

 **The Opportunity**


The Litigation Operations Manager is responsible for the operational execution of Top Dog Law's litigation function across all active states. This role serves as the primary implementation layer between firm leadership and state\- level litigation teams. A core responsibility of this role is the direct oversight, training, and accountability of Litigation Team Leads in each state, ensuring uniformity in how cases are managed from litigation through trial.

* Directly supervise Litigation Team Leads across all active states (FL, GA, MS, AZ, LA, NY, TN, IL)

**Litigation Operations Implementation**

* Implement and enforce firm\-wide litigation SOPs across all states, adapting for state\-specific court rules and procedural requirements
* Monitor compliance with phase timing benchmarks from filing through trial; escalate bottlenecks to the Regional Operations team.
* Oversee daily operational workflows including task management, deadline tracking, court filing compliance, and case phase movement
* Partner with Team Leads to ensure caseload assignments are balanced against capacity and case complexity
* Coordinate cross\-state operational initiatives, ensuring consistent execution regardless of jurisdiction

**Training \& Standards**

* Design and deliver litigation\-specific training for Team Leads and litigation staff on Filevine, case management protocols, court procedures, and SOL compliance.

**Data \& Reporting**

* Monitor litigation performance metrics across states using Filevine and BigQuery dashboards

**What You Bring**

**Required:**

* 5\+ years of experience in personal injury litigation operations, legal operations management, or a senior paralegal leadership role
* Prior experience supervising or training litigation staff across multiple offices or jurisdictions strongly preferred
* Deep familiarity with litigation case management platforms; Filevine experience a plus
* Strong working knowledge of personal injury litigation workflows — from filing through trial — across multiple states
* Demonstrated ability to implement SOPs, hold teams accountable to standards, and drive performance through others
* Comfortable working with data and performance metrics; ability to read dashboards and translate findings into operational action
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to work effectively with attorneys, paralegals, and firm leadership

 **Who Thrives Here (Core Values)**


We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

* **Committed:** You care deeply, have your teammates' backs, and show up to build something lasting.
* **No\-Ego Energy:** Positive, professional, and solutions\-oriented. Drama stays at the door.

* **Fast \& Hungry:** You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

**Job Title: Quality Manager (Remote \| Telehealth)**


**Location:** Remote \- United States


**Employment Type:** FT W2


**Salaried:** $83,000 \- $93,000



**CareTalk Health**



CareTalk Health is a fully remote, nationwide virtual medical practice. We partner with Medicare Advantage plans to deliver Annual Wellness Visits and close care gaps, reaching members wherever they are. We believe virtual care isn't a compromise — it's care delivered the way patients actually want it. Our job is to make that experience simple, reliable, and human.


**About the Role**



The Quality Manager owns quality across the organization, from the quality of calls made by RNs, providers, and PSS Engagers to clinical quality outcomes at the population level. This role requires a Registered Nurse who combines strong clinical judgment with excellent computer skills and hands\-on experience developing and analyzing quality data. The Quality Manager builds and leads a team of Quality Reviewers, sets the standards and methods they audit against, and turns their findings into measurable improvement across clinical and service quality. This role reports to the SVP of Clinical Services.



**What You'll Do**


**Key Responsibilities**



**Quality Program Oversight**


* Own quality performance across all clinical tiers and channels, including RN, provider, PSS, and Engager call and documentation quality, and organization\-wide clinical quality outcomes.
* Define and maintain quality standards, audit criteria, and scorecards used to evaluate calls, clinical interactions, and documentation.
* Set the quality strategy and roadmap in partnership with the SVP of Clinical Services, translating organizational goals into a concrete audit and improvement plan.
* Monitor clinical quality outcomes (e.g., HEDIS and other quality measures) and ensure quality review activity is aligned to closing gaps and improving results.


**Team Leadership**


* Hire, supervise, and develop a team of Quality Reviewers; assign workload, set performance expectations, and manage day\-to\-day team operations.
* Conduct calibration sessions across reviewers to ensure consistent, defensible scoring of calls and documentation.
* Coach and mentor Quality Reviewers, and build their skills in chart review, call evaluation, and constructive provider feedback.
* Own performance management for the Quality Reviewer team, including regular one\-on\-ones, feedback, and development plans.


**Data Development \& Analysis**


* Design and maintain quality dashboards and reporting tools that track call quality, clinical outcomes, and reviewer performance over time.
* Build and analyze datasets to identify trends, root causes, and improvement opportunities across providers, RNs, and PSS Engagers.
* Apply strong computer and analytical skills (e.g., Excel, reporting tools, QA platforms) to turn raw audit data into actionable insight.
* Present quality findings, trends, and recommendations to the SVP of Clinical Services and other executive leadership.


**Coaching, Compliance \& Cross\-Functional Work**


* Partner with clinical leadership to design improvement plans and targeted education based on quality findings.
* Ensure clinical documentation and interactions meet internal standards, clinical protocols, and regulatory requirements.
* Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on quality standards, interpreting guidelines consistently across care teams.
* Participate in incident reviews, root cause analyses, and internal or external audits as needed.
* Collaborate with operations, compliance, and QA\-adjacent teams to align quality metrics, workflows, and reporting.


**Required**



* Active, unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license required; multi\-state license compact.
* 3\+ years of clinical experience, including telehealth, ambulatory, or chronic care management preferred.
* Prior experience in quality management, quality assurance, or clinical audit within a healthcare setting; supervisory or team\-lead experience strongly preferred.
* Excellent computer skills, including demonstrated experience building and analyzing data (e.g., dashboards, spreadsheets, quality scorecards, BI tools).
* Comfortable using EMRs, CRM platforms, call recording tools, and QA dashboards.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to deliver direct, constructive feedback to providers, RNs, and clinical staff.
**Success Traits*** Sound clinical judgment paired with a rigorous, data\-driven approach to quality.
* Effective people leader who develops reviewers and holds a consistent quality bar.
* Focused on continuous improvement in both service quality and clinical outcomes.


**Work Location Requirement**



This is a remote U.S.\-based position. Employees must perform all work physically within the United States. International work is not permitted during scheduled work hours.


**Work Environment**



This is a remote position and may be "on camera" at any time. The Trainer will work from a home office, requiring reliable internet connectivity and a secure, private workspace.

* **Computer:**
	+ Windows or Apple (macOS) Computer ONLY (NO Chromebooks, Linux Machines, or Smartphones)

**Operations Manager — Financially SMART**

**About Financially SMART**

Financially SMART is a fractional CFO and outsourced accounting firm built exclusively for wealth management firms and RIAs. We serve advisory firms through a pod\-based model — each client is supported by a dedicated bookkeeper, senior accountant, and advisor — and we pair that service with FinSights AI, our proprietary financial analytics platform that gives clients real\-time dashboards, benchmarking, and AI\-driven commentary.

We've grown to a 13\-person team in under three years. Now we need someone to make sure the machine runs as well as the people in it.

**The Role**

The Operations Manager is the connective tissue of the firm. You'll own how work moves through Financially SMART — making sure every client deliverable goes out on time and to standard, our CRM reflects reality, and our team operates from one playbook instead of many. You'll report directly to the Founder and partner closely with our Director of Finance, accounting pods, and client advisors.

This is a builder role. You'll inherit a strong team and good systems, and your job is to tighten them, connect them, and scale them.

What You'll Do

**Service delivery \& deliverables oversight**

* Track and manage the monthly delivery calendar across all clients — closes, financial packages, reports, dashboards, and forecasts
* Monitor pod workloads and deadlines; spot bottlenecks early and reallocate or escalate before clients feel it
* Own quality\-control checkpoints so every deliverable meets the firm standard before it goes out
* Drive adoption of standardized processes, including our month\-end close checklist, across every pod

**CRM \& workflow management (FinancialCents)**

* Serve as the owner and administrator of our CRM/workflow system
* Build and maintain recurring task templates, workflows, and client records so the system is the single source of truth
* Hold the team accountable to keeping tasks, statuses, and notes current
* Produce weekly operational reporting: deliverable status, overdue items, capacity, and client health

**Firm operations \& alignment**

* Run internal operating cadences — weekly team syncs, pod check\-ins, and status reviews
* Document and improve SOPs for client onboarding, offboarding, and core service workflows
* Coordinate new client onboarding from signed engagement through first deliverable
* Support hiring and onboarding of new team members, including offshore staff
* Identify gaps between sales, service, and FinSights, and close them
* Act as a point of escalation for operational and client\-service issues

What You Bring

* 4\+ years in operations, practice management, or service delivery — ideally at an accounting firm, outsourced accounting/CAS practice, or professional services firm
* Proven experience owning a CRM or practice management tool (FinancialCents, Karbon, Canopy, TaxDome, Asana, or similar)
* A systems mindset — you see a recurring problem and build the process that fixes it permanently
* Strong organization and follow\-through across dozens of moving deadlines
* Comfortable holding a team accountable with clarity and respect
* Working knowledge of accounting workflows (month\-end close, financial reporting); QuickBooks Online familiarity is a plus
* Clear, concise communicator, both written and verbal

**Bonus points**

* Experience in or around wealth management, RIAs, or financial services
* Experience managing or coordinating remote and offshore teams
* Background scaling a firm through a growth phase

Why Financially SMART

* Direct access to the Founder and real influence over how the firm is built
* A growing, niche firm with a clear specialty and a proprietary tech platform
* Fully remote team
* \[Benefits: health, PTO, 401(k), etc.]

To Apply

Submit your resume and a short note describing a process or system you built that made a team run better — what was broken, what you changed, and the result.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $72,500\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan

Have you been looking for a company that you can get behind and feel good about the impact it has on sustainability and recycling efforts? Quest is a full\-service environmental consulting and management group supporting the efforts of Fortune 500 companies seeking to maximize profits and mitigate risks and minimize their ecological footprints.

If you want an opportunity where your efforts make an impact, Quest has an opportunity for you. The ideal person must be able to multi\-task, work independently and have strong attention to detail while being able to collaboratively communicate across departments.

**Why Work at Quest?**  
First off, we practice what we preach. We focus every day on recycling, reusing and repurposing where we can, and being socially responsible.

Finally, we are just a modern, FUN and collaborative work environment. We’re a smaller company that provides opportunities for employees to advance within the company, so there is always room to grow. We offer a casual business environment (so, you can wear jeans), great incentives and rewards with a quarterly recognition program.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Sales Operations \& Implementation Manager is responsible for aligning strategic sales initiatives with operational execution, guiding opportunities through the sales pipeline to implementation and live launch. This role combines sales operations support for the National Sales Managers (NSMs) with hands\-on project management of new client and wallet share implementations, ensuring stage\-gate requirements are met before deals progress and that established deadlines are met at each pipeline stage through launch.

The Manager oversees sales processes, CRM utilization, lead board maintenance, sales enablement, and reporting functions, and serves as the primary point of coordination between Sales, Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, and Key Accounts throughout the sales\-to\-launch lifecycle.

This role requires strong project management skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation timelines, along with the cross\-functional relationship\-building skills to keep deals and launches on track across Sales, Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, Key Accounts, and Operations.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION**

* **Sales Process \& CRM Management:** Supports the SVP of Sales and Marketing in designing and maintaining SOPs for all sales activities, leads onboarding and CRM training for new NSMs, and builds and optimizes dashboards for executive reporting, individual sales rep performance, and pipeline/funnel tracking.
* **Lead Management \& Sales Enablement:** Owns and manages the sales lead board, partnering with Marketing on lead generation strategy and tracking lead performance and conversion metrics. Leads sales enablement efforts — training, tools, and resources — that support NSM effectiveness, and partners closely with NSMs to prioritize outreach and target account alignment.
* **Pipeline Stage\-Gate Ownership:** Establishes and maintains stage\-gate criteria for each phase of the sales pipeline. Acts as the opportunity validator, ensuring required documentation and approvals — including signed MNDA, signed LOA where applicable, site lists, and invoices/spend data — are complete before an opportunity advances to the next stage.
* **Vendor Pricing \& Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Partners closely with Business Solutions and Vendor Relations to ensure vendor pricing and bids are received on timeto support proposal and closing timelines, and coordinates with Key Accounts and other stakeholders to confirm deal readiness at each stage gate.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred.
* 5\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Enablement, Implementation, Project Management, or a related field.
* Strong project management skills, with proven ability to manage multiple concurrent implementation timelines and cross\-functional workstreams.
* Proven ability to manage and improve sales systems, processes, and cross\-functional workflows.
* Demonstrated success in coaching, supporting, and guiding team members in a high\-performance sales environment.
* Proficient with CRM, sales engagement, and project management platforms/tools.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data\-driven recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to influence and collaborate across departments, including Business Solutions, Vendor Relations, and Key Accounts.
* Experience developing SOPs, performance dashboards, and sales/implementation reports for both executive and team\-level use.
* Skilled in lead management processes, pipeline optimization, and stage\-gate/deal qualification strategies.

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
###### **A NOTE ON HOW TO REACH US**


We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

#### **About Foundant**


At Foundant, we build mission\-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.


We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of \~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

#### **Where You’ll Work:**

* As a remote\-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
* With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
##### ***What******You’ll******Do:***

* You'll build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients across our portfolio, serving as a strategic advisor and advocate — because renewals are built on relationships, not just contracts
* You'll own the renewal process end to end and proactively identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities aligned with client goals and product capabilities
* You'll track and assess client engagement, satisfaction, and usage metrics to ensure high retention and get ahead of churn risk
* You'll partner closely with Customer Success to align on client needs, share feedback, and coordinate efforts that drive client success — because we do more good when we work together
* You'll develop account plans for key clients, outlining growth strategies, risk mitigation, and engagement tactics
* You'll maintain a deep understanding of Foundant, GivingData, and SmartSimple offerings so you can guide clients toward the solutions and outcomes that matter most to their mission
* Other duties as assigned

##### ***What******You’ll******Need:***

* 3\+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related role in SaaS or technology environments
* A proven track record of managing renewals and driving upsell/cross\-sell outcomes
* Experience working cross\-functionally in a fast\-paced, client\-centric environment
* Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and customer success platforms
* Must be legally eligible to work in Canada or the United States

**Preferred:**

* Experience in the nonprofit, philanthropic, or government sectors
* Understanding of SaaS metrics and client health scoring

##### ***What******You’ll******Bring to our Team Dynamics:***

* **Adaptive Achievement:** Owns a full renewal pipeline independently — juggling multiple accounts and deadlines, and adapting account plans as client needs and priorities shift
* **Productive Collaboration:** Builds trusted, cross\-functional relationships with Customer Success and other internal teams to keep client outcomes aligned, because we do more good together
* **Service Orientation:** Anticipates client needs before renewal conversations happen, understanding that a client's success is what makes the relationship — and the business — sustainable
* **Business Insight:** Understands how Foundant, GivingData, and SmartSimple solutions drive measurable outcomes for organizations in the philanthropic and social good sector, and uses that knowledge to identify genuine upsell and cross\-sell opportunities

##### ***Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:***

* At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not\-for\-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real\-world change.
* We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
* With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well\-being and professional success.
* We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
* As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
* You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
* Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

  

Foundant is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse workforce that represents the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates, and will consider all applicants

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
Customer Success Manager

About TSOLife

TSOLife is an AI\-powered resident insight and experience platform providing automated data collection, business intelligence, and actionable insights for the senior living industry. We leverage cutting\-edge technology to allow businesses to make data\-informed decisions and truly personalize the resident experience.

Customer Success Team

The Customer Success team owns the customer journey from onboarding through adoption, retention, and growth. We combine high\-touch relationship management with data, technology, and proactive account strategy to ensure customers realize measurable value from TSOLife. Our CSMs are growth partners who identify risk early, drive adoption across their accounts, and continuously look for opportunities to deepen customer value.

The Role

The Customer Success Manager owns the success and growth of an assigned portfolio of TSOLife customers. You will build trusted relationships from community users through corporate executives while using account data, platform adoption, and customer goals to determine where to focus your attention.

This is a proactive role. You will be expected to identify risk before the customer raises it, drive adoption when usage is falling short, lead difficult conversations when necessary, and recognize opportunities to expand the relationship.

**Position Type**

Fulltime, Salary

**Location**

Remote

**What You’ll Do**

**Own the Full Customer Lifecycle**

* Serve as the primary strategic point of contact, building trusted relationships with community users and corporate stakeholders.
* Own the full implementation and onboarding lifecycle for assigned accounts.

**Drive Account Health, Retention \& Growth**

* Monitor engagement and platform usage and adoption metrics, proactively diagnosing barriers and executing corrective action plans before they become retention risks.
* Identify and pursue expansion opportunities as accounts mature, translating usage patterns into a broader growth strategy.
* Deliver QBRs and executive reporting that demonstrate value, insights, outcomes, and forward strategy to senior stakeholders.

**Champion Full Feature Product Adoption**

* Stay fluent in all TSOLife products and updates, enabling accurate communication and guidance for customers across our full solution set — not just the module they started with.
* Create and maintain training and enablement resources to accelerate adoption and support new releases.
* Provide timely, high\-quality support that resolves issues and keeps daily operations running smoothly for every account.

**Partner Across the Business**

* Advocate for customer needs internally, gathering feedback and partnering with Product, Engineering, and leadership on improvements.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure a cohesive customer experience that supports company\-wide objectives.
* Ensure the timely delivery of customer\-facing assets, including calendars, newsletters, and monthly content, as applicable.

**Build Repeatable Customer Success Practices**

* Maintain accurate documentation and reporting on account status, risks, value metrics, and engagement activities.
* Champion industry best practices and emerging trends to continuously raise the bar on customer outcomes.
* Take on additional responsibilities as they arise — this is a builder's seat in a growing department.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Proven Customer Success Ownership**

* Experience owning the full customer relationship \- onboarding, adoption, retention, and growth with a track record of proactively catching account risk before it becomes a churn conversation, not just responding to tickets as they come in.

**Product Comprehension**

* The ability to learn a multi\-module SaaS platform deeply enough to recognize when a customer's actual goals call for a different or additional part of the product than what they originally asked for.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Comfort operating as the bridge between Product, Support, Sales, and the customer, translating customer feedback into something the internal team can act on, and translating roadmap and constraints into something a community or corporate stakeholder can understand.

**Business \& Data Fluency**

* Ability to walk a corporate stakeholder through usage metrics, adoption trends, and ROI in a QBR, and tie those numbers to a forward strategy — not just deliver a relationship\-first status update.
* Comfortable balancing white\-glove service with hard conversations about risk and performance.

**High\-Touch Service at Scale**

* Experience providing individualized, high\-touch service to enterprise or senior\-living\-caliber accounts, with the judgment to know when a tailored approach is worth the extra effort and when it isn't.

**Creative Problem Solving**

* A resourceful, first\-principles approach to genuinely ambiguous problems — finding workarounds within real constraints rather than stalling at “that's not possible,” without cutting corners on documentation, security, or scope.

**Execution at Volume**

* Strong personal systems for managing a full portfolio of accounts simultaneously, with the organizational discipline to make sure nothing goes quiet even as volume grows.
* Shown Project management and process development experience

**Industry \& Technical Fluency**

* Experience in senior living, healthcare, or another relationship\-intensive service industry preferred.
* High comfort with technology, including messaging, video conferencing, workflow, and database tools.

**Values Alignment:** 

* A genuine fit with TSOLife's values Integrity, Learning, Resilience, Compassion, Self\-Awareness, and Team Work.

Why You’ll Love it Here

* **Make a Difference:** Your work measurably improves quality of life for 230,000\+ senior living residents.
* **Passionate Team:** Workwith a great, mission\-driven team with shared, unwavering purpose and drive.
* **Competitive Compensation \& Benefit

new_jobs.title: Account Manager - Mid Market
new_jobs.description:
Rightworks offers the only intelligent cloud purpose\-built for accounting firms and professionals. Backed by award\-winning support, our fully managed IT and applications ensure customers have secure, reliable, on\-demand access to their technology. We provide a curated software ecosystem that simplifies the complexity of running an accounting firm or small business, supported by a community of thought leaders, peer networks, and educational resources. Our success is made possible by leveraging decades of specialized experience in leading accounting firms, SMBs and technology companies. Thousands of Firms and SMBs count on us to run their business every day.  

  

We have a great team, we’re growing fast and have a winning culture based on innovation, teamwork, and mutual respect.  

  

**Job Overview**  

We are looking for an experienced Account Manager to join the Rightworks Team. This team is specifically geared toward nurturing and growing relationships within our base of existing customers. Account Managers use a consultative approach, making sure clients understand all things related to Rightworks and advising on how they can receive more value by using additional services alongside their existing subscriptions. Reporting to the Sales Manager, a successful Account Manager sets appointments, fosters relationships, closes deals, and manages their own pipeline.  

This is a remote position, with hybrid options for candidates near a Rightworks office.  

  

**Responsibilities**  

* Establish ongoing relationships with a customer base coming from multiple channels, and lead high\-level consultative calls outlining the many ways a firm can leverage its relationship with Rightworks
* Engage our customer audience and introduce Rightworks as the one\-stop technology solution, with offerings ranging from QuickBooks hosting to fully outsourced IT
* Manage regular forecasting and pipeline reporting
* Manage assigned accounts, field customer inquiries, and route items as needed
* Conduct heavy outbound calling and emailing to set up regular appointments
* Meet or exceed all quota targets \- monthly, quarterly, and annually
* Collaborate closely with Product \& Marketing, as well as channel teams
* Suggest and implement improvements to the sales process
* Maintain a current, working knowledge of the accounting industry \- trends, competitors, and software
* Travel as needed for association and industry events and customer visits

  

**Requirements**  

* 3\-5 years of SaaS sales experience
* Preferred: 3\-5 years of experience selling technology to accounting firms
* Preferred: experience with prospecting and sales productivity tools (Groove, Clari, Salesforce)
* Experience building pipeline through outbound prospecting
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales quota
* Excellent interpersonal and team collaboration skills
* Excellent presentation skills
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Numerical aptitude and a problem\-solving mindset
* Bachelor's degree preferred, or equivalent practical experience

  

**Eligibility Requirements**  

* This role is open to US Citizens or permanent residents authorized to work in the United States. Rightworks LLC is unable to offer visa sponsorship.
* Due to specific state regulations, we are unable to accept applications from residents of California, Hawaii, or Alaska.
* Relocation will not be offered for this position.

  

**Compensation**  

  

Our Compensation range for this role is $120,000 OTE, and is determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, and internal equity.  

  

**Benefits**  

  

To provide best\-in\-class solutions, we need a best\-in\-class team. We offer competitive salaries to recruit the best talent. We provide company\-paid short and long\-term disability insurance, life insurance and a generous 401K match. We offer highly affordable medical, dental, vision coverage, and many other valuable benefits. We offer flexible PTO, and numerous paid holidays, affording you the time to be there for what is important in your life. We encourage giving back to our communities by providing paid volunteer time off. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer!

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Northeast)
new_jobs.description:
Ajax Systems is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4\.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end\-to\-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like\-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems.

The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry\-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.
### **Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 5 years’ professional experience in alarm systems, video surveillance, access control and fire systems.
* Proven hands\-on experience in designing and installing video surveillance, fire alarm, or other security systems.
* Experience delivering offline and online technical training to technical audiences.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Flexible and willing to travel for business trips, trade shows, and other professional events.
* Self\-motivated and independent, with an outgoing personality and a proactive approach to work.
* NICET and ESA certifications

### **Responsibilities:**

* Conduct technical seminars, exhibitions, presentations, and webinars on Ajax products for both customers and company employees.
* Present product roadmaps and new feature updates to Ajax Systems distributors and dealers.
* Proactively manage and schedule open classes, private classes and on\-demand requests for training and support for Ajax products and technologies.
* Promote and demonstrate product solutions tailored to customer requirements; provide technical consultations and support to key clients.
* Perform market research and competitive product analysis to identify strengths, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with key company partners.
* Test product features and prepare technical documentation for new products and solutions, collaborating closely with cross\-functional teams.
* Support the sales team by following up on leads through the company’s CRM portal.
* Analyze customer needs in partnership with the sales department to identify optimal product solutions.
* Actively participate in the beta testing of new products and services providing expert feedback to product management to refine solutions.

### **We offer:**

* Competitive compensation that includes a base salary and performance\-based bonuses
* Car allowance, petrol and all business costs covered by the company
* Health \& Life insurance
* 401(k)
* Growth Opportunities
* Impactful work
* Innovative Environment

**About ForumWithin**

ForumWithin helps companies build stronger, more connected cultures through peer groups, executive coaching, and team facilitation. We take the peer\-forum model that's long powered CEO networks like YPO and EO and bring it inside organizations, creating small, confidential groups where employees and leaders can talk openly about real challenges, build trust, and grow their emotional intelligence, communication, and leadership.

Right now, most of our work centers on building peer groups within companies, cross\-functional, department\-level, or leadership cohorts that meet regularly with a trained facilitator to work through real workplace dynamics like accountability, collaboration, and communication across teams. We pair that with one\-on\-one executive coaching and hands\-on team facilitation, all aimed at the same outcome: helping people have better conversations at work, build genuine trust with the people around them, and lead with more self\-awareness. We're a small, close\-knit team, and we're looking for someone who thrives on keeping the behind\-the\-scenes systems running smoothly so the rest of us can focus on the people we serve.

**About the Role**

We're hiring an Operations Coordinator to help our small team stay organized, on schedule, and on top of client communication. * Prior experience in an administrative, executive assistant, or virtual assistant role

* Reliable self\-direction: you can manage your own schedule and follow through with minimal oversight

* 15\-20 hours per week, contractor (1099\)

* Fully remote; candidates must be based in the Eastern or Central time zone

Please send your resume and a brief email telling us why you're a good fit to erinross@forumwithin.com. We'll follow up with next steps for candidates who seem like a good fit.

new_jobs.title: 1099 Call Center Partner / Independent Call Center Operator
new_jobs.description:
1099 Call Center Partner / Independent Call Center OperatorBuild Your Own Sales Operation. Sell Established Services. Earn Based on What You Build.

**Independent Contractor \| 1099 \| Commission\-Based \| Entrepreneurial Opportunity \| Remote**

About the Opportunity

Castille Group is expanding.

As we enter new markets, industries, and areas of business, we are looking for **hungry, experienced sales professionals and entrepreneurial operators** who want to do more than work another sales job.

We are looking for people who want to **build something of their own.**

The opportunity is for an **Independent Call Center Operator / 1099 Call Center Partner** who will independently build and operate a sales team focused on generating new business for an assigned Castille Group company, service, market, territory, or industry.

This is **not an employment position.**

You will not be joining Castille Group as an employee, and this is not a salaried call\-center management job.

Instead, you will operate as an **independent business partner** responsible for building and managing your own sales operation.

Think of the model as being **similar in structure to a franchise or independent sales operation**, but without purchasing a traditional physical franchise location.

Castille Group provides the established service, commercial framework, sales resources, lead opportunities, and fulfillment infrastructure.

**You build and operate the sales organization.**

If you are looking for a guaranteed salary, hourly pay, a company\-provided sales team, or a position where someone else handles the difficult parts of building a sales operation, **this is not for you.**

If you want the opportunity to build a sales organization where your income can grow according to the amount of business you generate, **keep reading.**

What You Will Do

As an Independent Call Center Partner, you will be responsible for developing and operating your own outbound sales operation.

Your primary objective is simple:

**Build a team. Generate conversations. Generate customers. Build revenue.**

You will determine how you build your operation, including how you recruit, organize, manage, motivate, and compensate your sales team.

Your responsibilities may include:

* Building your own outbound calling operation
* Recruiting and selecting callers/sales representatives
* Training and supervising your sales team
* Establishing your team's daily and weekly activity expectations
* Managing call volume and sales activity
* Monitoring performance and conversion rates
* Developing your team's sales culture
* Coaching underperforming representatives
* Replacing representatives who do not perform
* Scaling your team when performance justifies expansion
* Managing your team's calling infrastructure
* Selecting and paying for your own telecommunications/calling tools
* Managing your own operating expenses
* Prospecting and following up with potential customers
* Using Castille\-approved sales materials and positioning
* Selling the assigned Castille Group service
* Maintaining accurate sales attribution
* Communicating closed opportunities to Castille
* Working with Castille through the customer onboarding process
* Continuously improving your team's sales performance

You are not expected to simply manage a team that **Castille gives you.**

**You are expected to build the team.**

You Choose How You Build Your Team

One of the biggest advantages of this model is that **you decide how you want to build your sales organization.**

Castille Group does not require you to operate a traditional physical call center or hire a local team.

You may build your operation:

* Locally
* Remotely
* With a U.S.\-based team
* With an international team
* With a combination of U.S. and international representatives
* Through a hybrid operating model

For example, an operator based in the United States may choose to build the business development and management side of their operation themselves while recruiting and managing a remote calling team.

Our Preferred Operator Profile

We are particularly interested in **U.S.\-based sales professionals and entrepreneurs who understand the U.S. market and want to build a sales operation that can scale beyond their own personal selling capacity.**

You may already have experience in sales, call centers, lead generation, recruiting, outsourcing, or business development.

You may also already understand how to build a remote or offshore team.

If you are an experienced U.S. salesperson who has thought:

"I could sell this if I had a team making the calls for me."

this opportunity may be a strong fit.

Remote \& Philippines\-Based Teams

If you choose to build a remote or international sales operation, **Castille Group can provide additional guidance based on our experience operating around the United States and Philippines.**

This may include general guidance around:

* Where to look for potential representatives
* Recruiting channels
* Structuring a remote team
* Working with independent contractors
* Recruiting sales representatives in the Philippines
* General considerations when building a U.S.\-focused sales team with Philippines\-based callers
* Scaling an outsourced calling operation

This guidance is intended to help you build your own operation.

**Castille does not recruit, employ, or manage your sales representatives for you.**

You remain responsible for your own recruitment, selection, engagement, compensation, management, and operating expenses.

You decide whether your team is located in the United States, the Philippines, another location, or a combination of locations.

**You build the team. You manage the team. You determine how you operate.**

What Castille Group Provides

Castille Group is building and expanding a portfolio of companies across multiple industries.

As an independent partner, you receive access to the commercial infrastructure necessary to sell an established Castille Gro

new_jobs.title: SEO Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**SEO Account Manager (Contract, Remote)**

We're one of the top marketing firms in the home services industry, and we're looking for quality\-obsessed SEO Account Managers to join our team.

As an SEO Account Manager for Level 10 Contractor, you'll be given 10 to 15 clients and be completely responsible for following our SEO policies and procedures to create a successful lead generation experience.

Client partner communication comes first. Every client hears from you on a weekly to bi\-weekly basis with a clear report on how their account is performing. Not a data dump. A real read on what's working, what isn't, and what you're doing about it. You'll also work with our internal team to make sure tracking is set up correctly and stays that way, because you can't report on results you aren't measuring. Most agencies go quiet between invoices. We don't, and that's the single biggest reason our client partners stay. If you're the kind of person who lets an email sit for three days, this isn't the role.

On top of that, there's a checklist of roughly 15 mini projects that get completed every single month. Without fail.

Most Account Managers grow their own responsibilities, and their compensation, by mastering our process and getting faster at it. The better you get, the more clients you can take on. You're paid a flat fee per month, per client, provided all required tasks are completed that month. The task list never changes. No surprises. No hunting for your next gig.

All the work you want means all the money you can make. Simple as that.

Here's the best part. We pay a flat $5,000 per month for your first 3 months so you can learn how we do things, and so we can confirm you're following our protocols exactly. No fuss, no muss.

* Pay is on a client task list per month basis.
* The first 3 months carry a guaranteed $5,000 per month while you onboard.
* You will never have to find new clients or sell in any way.
* You'll have a management team, other AMs, and a small support staff behind you.
* You're walking into a proven company as a team member, not starting from scratch.

Our standards are high. We typically interview 1 to 3% of applicants for this full\-time contract remote position.

**The honest downsides**

* The work can be repetitive and tedious.
* If you don't have a quiet workspace, high\-speed internet, a Windows based PC, and a willingness to do most of your work during normal business hours, you will probably fail at this.
* Initial feedback can be substantial.
* Our standards are incredibly high for both work product and attitude. (Look up "The Blue Vase" story to understand the kind of attitude we're after.)

**The upsides**

* After your 3\-month probation period, your income is up to you. We guarantee a minimum of $60k per year.
* Real support. Reviews, training, and one\-on\-one time.
* Merit\-based advancement.
* You get paid on time, every time.
* Endless work available.

**Requirements**

* Comfortable with back\-end requirements.
* Comfortable receiving a high volume of feedback early on.
* 5\+ years of experience in local SEO, SEM, GA4, GSC, LSAs, and Facebook digital ads.
* Available for communication during normal working hours, 9 to 5 CST.
* Living within the continental United States.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: Remote
